description: This file contains internal hash function implementations based on MurmurHash3, including functions for rotating bits, getting unaligned blocks, and finalizing hash values. It defines inline functions for 32-bit and 64-bit hash operations, as well as a public hash API.

methods.name: hash_get_block_32
methods.description: Retrieves a 32-bit block from possibly unaligned memory.

methods.name: hash_get_block_64
methods.description: Retrieves a 64-bit block from possibly unaligned memory.

methods.name: hash_fmix_32
methods.description: Final mixing step for 32-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_fmix_64
methods.description: Final mixing step for 64-bit hash values.

methods.name: hash_x86_128
methods.description: Hash function producing 128-bit hash for x86 architecture.

methods.name: hash_x64_128
methods.description: Hash function producing 128-bit hash for x64 architecture.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Public API function that computes hash values based on architecture.
